title: Center of Mass of Body with Cavity (Negative Mass Superposition)

variables.\\vec{r}_{\\text{rem}}: Center of mass position vector of remaining body with cavity
variables.M: Mass of original complete body without cavity
variables.\\vec{r}_{\\text{orig}}: Center of mass position vector of original complete body
variables.m_{\\text{cav}}: Mass of removed material filling cavity
variables.\\vec{r}_{\\text{cav}}: Center of mass position vector of removed cavity portion

assumptions: Uniform density throughout original body and cavity region
validity_conditions: Applicable to planar laminas, 3D solids, and regular geometries
common_misuse: Adding cavity mass in denominator instead of subtracting
Using area instead of mass when thickness varies
